facts.business: Vivid Mercantile Limited operates as a trading-oriented enterprise focused on gold, silver, diamond, and jewellery ornaments, engaged in sourcing, maintaining inventory, and undertaking retail and wholesale transactions.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Board approved a rights issue of up to approximately 5.01 crore Equity Shares at an issue price of ₹5 per Equity Share, aggregating to approximately ₹25.06 crore, with an entitlement ratio of 1 Equity Share for every 2 Equity Shares held.

key_risks: Prevailing prices of gold, silver and other precious materials
Developments in gold, diamond and commodity markets
